# core-v1_group_language_files (Data Source)

## Schema

### Required

- `group` (String) The application group for the language file

### Read-Only

- `languages` (Attributes List) List of available language files (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--languages))

### Nested Schema for `languages`

Read-Only:

- `content` (Attributes Map) The content of the language file (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--languages--content))
- `default` (Boolean) Indicates if this is the default language for this app
- `language` (String) The language code for this file
- `missing_locale` (Boolean) Indicates the requested locale was not found, so the default was returned
